Senior Gameplay Programmer on WHAT THE CAR?

Do you love working in small, creative teams turning wild ideas into a reality? What about having creative and technical ownership from ideation through to release? Read on!

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

WHAT THE CAR? is our absurdly silly racing adventure game which addresses fundamental questions such as… What if a car had legs? Or a jetpack? Or secretly identified as a sailboat? First launched in 2023 on Apple Arcade and now also on Steam, it has gained a steady following of dedicated fans who have contributed hundreds of thousands of community-built levels.

We’re looking for a Senior Gameplay Programmer to help us continue to build upon CAR’s success by expanding upon its absurdly silly universe! We believe the best people to come up with ideas are the ones implementing them, so we expect a high degree of creativity and game design knowledge from our Gameplay Programmers, in addition to their crazy tech skills. This role involves around 60% programming and 40% game design.

Here’s what that looks like day to day

• 
Build and ship gameplay code. You’ll implement features end-to-end in an existing Unity/C# codebase and ship regularly in a live environment.

• 
Generate design ideas. You’ll take part in shaping features, articulate intent, evaluate tradeoffs, and iterate through discussion with the team.

• 
Keep the game healthy. Fix bugs, improve systems, review test videos, and document findings so issues don’t come back to haunt us.

• 
Extend and refine what’s there. You’ll build on existing mechanics, making them more robust and enjoyable for players.

• 
Support and collaborate. You’re part of a small, closely knit, cross discipline team where people help each other reach their goals.

• 
Prototype and let go. Not everything ships, and that’s fine. Comfort with iteration and refactoring is part of the job.

You’re a great match if

• 
You have 8+ years of commercial game development experience, having shipped at least two games as part of a team

• 
You have strong Unity and C# skills. You’re comfortable navigating a shared codebase and writing maintainable code you’d be proud to hand off

• 
You care about stability, performance, and long-term maintainability, and you leave systems better than you found them

• 
You genuinely value collaboration and working very closely with every member of the team

• 
You approach other people’s ideas with openness and try to understand the intention before giving feedback or pushing back

Nice to have

• Experience working on live games

Requirements for any job at Triband

• 
You thrive in taking ownership - you spot problems, design and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• 
You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture

• 
You value a positive work environment

• 
You contribute to making the studio a fun and supportive place

Practicalities

• 
Primarily work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen

• 
Only open to candidates who are already eligible to work in Denmark as we don’t offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role

• 
37-hour work week, with flexible work hours

• 
No crunch, we put people before deadlines

• 
Our working language is English

We offer

• 
Silly but ambitious projects

• 
The chance to contribute to great games that reach millions of players

• 
A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged

• 
Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games

• 
A professional development budget to invest in your growth

• 
Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights and team events

• 
Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

Six weeks of paid vacation

• 
Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement

• 
Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked

• 
Pension plan and private health insurance

• 
Endless amounts of coffee

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 50 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn’t always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games - and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

Do you enjoy making systems? Are you also pretty silly? Would you like to collaborate with other creative people to make a game that makes people laugh?

Triband is working on our most ambitious project to date: a new systemic open-world game and a brand-new IP (this is not a WHAT THE? game). It’s something different, and currently still in the early days of development. As a Senior Game Programmer you'll be responsible for building the tech and underlying systems.

Here’s what that looks like day to day

• 
In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you'll build new features for a game with an existing tech infrastructure, continuously iterating on improvements.

• 
You’ll be one of the team’s domain experts, including balancing long-term code health with short-term needs and sharing best practices with your team mates.

• 
We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor.

• 
Overall, you'll make sure the project is great to work on.

This includes things like...

• 
Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility, with multi-platform support in mind.

• 
Implementing core systems, such as data storage, localization, analytics, etc.

• 
Helping designers, artists, and everyone else make their work as awesome as possible.

• 
At least 6 years of experience in game development in a similar role.

• 
Worked on multiple games as part of a team, and have been a part of the different stages of development.

• 
Proficiency in C# and a deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor, including its asset pipeline and editor tooling.

• 
Experience shipping iOS and macOS apps with hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework, using Xcode and Swift.

Nice-to-haves

• 
Experience maintaining a live game, including coordinating and implementing updates, managing app store submissions, and keeping a live player base happy.

• 
Experience with Unity rendering pipeline, shader programming, and performance optimization for different platforms.

• 
Experience working with automated build pipelines like Jenkins.

We also care a lot about experimentation. Sometimes the weird idea is not the right fit. Sometimes the weird idea is the entire game! The trick is being able to explore it together, learn from it, and not get too precious when the experience tells us we’re wrong.

jobs.description:
We're looking for a senior AI engineer with hands-on experience in generative AI, API integrations, and advanced agent-based applications. The ideal candidate brings a mix of full-stack, AI, and cloud engineering experience.

**What You'll Do

**This role cuts across multiple tech stacks and is a central part of how we deliver AI solutions for our clients.

**In This Role, You'll

**

• Translating early ideas into working prototypes and iterating them into production-ready solutions using modern full-stack frameworks

• Designing and deploying generative AI applications and autonomous agents using LLM APIs and established agent frameworks

• Integrating AI capabilities into client systems and managing deployment pipelines in cloud environments

• Collaborating with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to build solutions that address real needs

• Mentoring junior engineers and keeping pace with emerging AI and software engineering paradigms

**What You'll Bring

**We're looking for someone with at least five years of software development experience, including at least two in generative AI and agent-based applications, and a master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

**Beyond That, You'll Bring

**

• Full-stack capability across TypeScript (React, Next.js, Vite) and Python, with experience shipping production systems

• Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, Agno, or DSPy

• Proficiency with RESTful APIs, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and containerisation tools such as Docker and Kubernetes

• Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders

Relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus. English is our corporate language; however, proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus for this role.

**What We Offer

**You'll join a fast-growing team backed by Implement Consulting Group — nerdy by nature, genuinely curious about both technology and people, and serious about craft. You'll have real autonomy, a strong culture of learning, and meaningful AI challenges across industries.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the role once filled, so apply ASAP.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About The Tech Collective

**The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement. We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI and analytics, ensuring that they are fit for the digital future. Through co-creation and passionate advisory, we aim to make our clients’ data easy to handle and provide useful insights.

In our collective, you will find people with a combination of nerdiness and infectious energy. We are passionate about technology, but we also have a sincere interest in people.

At GetWhy, we’re on a mission to change the way brands understand people. We help the world's biggest brands get closer to their consumers—faster, smarter, and with a human touch - through breakthrough research powered by AI. Companies like Coca-Cola, Heineken, Unilever and more trust us to deliver consumer insights in hours, not weeks.

We are building an end-to-end AI-powered human insights platform, redefining the boundaries of qualitative research. To fuel our journey, we raised a $34.5M Series A investment from PeakSpan Capital in 2024, making it one of Denmark’s largest Series A rounds to date.

What the AI team does

We are dedicated to delivering high-quality AI products leveraging the latest tools and techniques and to serve them across our core products in a scalable way.

For this, we use classic machine learning for predictive models to deal with fraud detection, language classification, visual understanding and automating internal workflows. These make heavy use of video processing, speech-to-text and multilingual translations models and pipelines.

We also build a lot of functionality around state of the art LLMs. We treat off-the-shelf LLMs as future commodities and aim to benefit from their strengths while employing principled methodologies to build guardrails and fallback strategies for their weaknesses. We strive to achieve a deep understanding of prompt engineering, context management, and LLM behavior quirks (e.g., hallucinations, non-determinism, context management), by focusing on evaluation and observability through monitoring for latency, accuracy, and usage.

Who you are

We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our growing stellar AI team. You will be responsible for all stages in the machine learning lifecycles across projects, from designing and defining data annotation steps to model training, validation and deployment.

More Specifically, You Should Have These Minimum Qualifications

• At least 5+ years developing machine learning systems, in particular NLP models.

• Proficiency in Python, along with a solid understanding of data structures and algorithms, and the capability to write production-quality code.

• Significant experience working with LLMs at scale, Prompt Engineering and AI Agents.

• Solid understanding of LLM evaluation, dealing with hallucinations, inconsistent outputs, context management, conversational AI and voice technologies, including text-to-speech.

• Proven experience formulating hypotheses, conducting experiments, and analyzing results.

• Exceptional English skills, both spoken and in writing.

What you will do

• Build AI-powered features at scale using the latest advancements in LLMs.

• Research, prototype, and build advanced NLP/ML models to enable automated resolution of end-user problems.

• Design and conduct rigorous experiments and evaluations to enhance model accuracy and reliability.

• Refine prompts and tune hyper-parameters to maximize the performance of cutting-edge retrieval and generative AI systems.

• Work closely with researchers, engineers, and product teams to define feature scope and implementation strategies.

• Mentor junior team members and engage in collaborative learning with peers to promote knowledge sharing.

• Contribute to technical reviews and share expertise in ML methodologies and best practices

• Writing clean, maintainable, and well-structured code to meet delivery goals.

What we offer

• A highly ambitious AI team driven by sky-is-the-limit long term vision and goals, while working to identify and deliver intermediate milestones.

• A full-time position with a competitive salary plus benefits.

• A flexible work schedule with opportunities to work from home.

• A vibrant and international work environment with 60+ colleagues from 15+ nationalities.

• A modern, newly renovated Nordhavnen office with stunning waterfront views, office lunch, relaxation areas, gym, free daily energizers, snacks, and drinks.

• A company culture that values innovation, collaboration, and transparency.

• Annual company retreats and Friday bar events – we work hard, we celebrate hard.

How do I apply?

Click on the apply button and upload your resumé or LinkedIn profile. If we see a potential match, we’ll invite you for a conversation at our office to get to know you better and share more about our culture and this opportunity.

So, what are you waiting for? Hit the apply button and come join the next Danish unicorn.

Maersk’s Protective Services function helps keep our executive leadership, their families and designated senior leaders safe, connected and able to lead the business with confidence. We do this through intelligence-led advice, structured programmes and discreet coordination across the countries where Maersk operates.

We are looking for an Executive Protection Advisor to take ownership of our Executive Protection and Event Security programmes; co-own the executive scope of our Travel Risk Management programme and the family coverage within our Expat and Family Security Programme; and act as a trusted advisor to senior executives across Maersk and A.P. Moller Holding, as well as designated family members.

This role is for someone who leads through structure and judgement rather than visibility. You can balance operational delivery with programme development, build trust with senior stakeholders, and translate exposure into proportionate, discreet and workable solutions.

The role in brief

The Executive Protection Advisor is the trusted operational and advisory point of contact for our executive population and their closest support functions. The role sits at the centre of a global Protective Services team and works directly with the Head of Protective Services.

Approximately 60% of the role is operational. You will advise on executive travel, events, residences and family security situations; manage incidents and threats when they arise; and coordinate with Regional Heads of Security, vendors and authorities to ensure the right support is in the right place at the right time.

The remaining 40% is strategic. You will own and continuously develop the Executive Protection Programme and the Event Security Programme. You will also co-own the executive scope of Travel Risk Management and the coverage for families of Maersk’s executive leadership within our Expat and Family Security Programme, while contributing to the continued professional maturity of the function.

International travel is part of the role, including support for events, oversight of site visits, and the development and maintenance of vendor relationships. The role is based in Copenhagen.

What you will do

Programme ownership and development

·  Own the Executive Protection Programme (EPP), including its appendices, procedures and workflows, and ensure it remains current and operationally usable.

·  Own the Event Security Programme (ESP), including triggers, templates, planning standards and governance.

·  Co-own the executive travel scope of our Travel Risk Management programme and the family coverage within our Expat and Family Security Programme.

·  Prepare decision-ready executive briefings for leadership review and approval.

Executive, family and residential advisory

·  Act as the trusted contact for senior executives and designated family members on protective services matters.

·  Conduct individual exposure assessments and translate findings into proportionate, discreet, and practical measures.

·  Coordinate residential security across alarms, access control, surveillance, physical improvements and vendor delivery.

Executive travel and event coordination

·  Coordinate protective services for senior executive travel.

·  Plan and oversee event security for leadership events, off-sites and public engagements.

·  Coordinate with Regional Heads of Security, local offices, vendors and authorities to ensure consistent delivery.

Incident, threat and harassment case management

·  Lead the initial assessment of threats, harassment or incidents affecting executives, family members, or company locations.

·  Coordinate with Global Threat Intelligence, Cyber Security, Legal, HQ Security, and relevant authorities.

·  Maintain clear documentation, follow-up actions, and After-Action Reviews.

Intelligence, vendors and authorities

·  Define Protective Services’ intelligence requirements and coordinate with Global Threat Intelligence.

·  Support vendor evaluations, RFP processes and procurement collaboration across executive protection, residential security, event security and intelligence suppliers.

·  Build and maintain professional relationships with Danish and international police, authorities and security partners.

Training and onboarding

·  Deliver security onboarding and briefings for new members of Maersk’s executive leadership, Executive Assistants and relevant support functions.

·  Develop audience-appropriate awareness materials, briefings, and checklists.

About you

You are a trusted advisor, not a frontline operator. You bring the composure of someone who has worked closely with senior leadership, and you understand that judgement and discretion matter more than visibility in this environment.

You are structured, take ownership and follow matters through to closure. You are comfortable with ambiguity, able to bring orders to incomplete information, and confident in turning it into a workable plan.

You are proactive and anticipate what is coming. You engage early with Executive Assistants, regional partners and vendors, ensuring Protective Services remains a step ahead.

You communicate with clarity and confidence. You can turn a complex security topic into a concise, decision-ready briefing for a senior leader, and you can raise concerns respectfully but firmly when the situation requires it.

You understand that this is a people-focused role. Trust is the foundation, discretion is the standard and continuity is essential to effective delivery.

Qualifications

Required

·  Danish citizenship, as the role requires eligibility for national security clearance and professional cooperation with Danish authorities, including the Police and PET.

·  A relevant background in corporate protective services, executive protection, security risk management, intelligence, police, military or diplomatic security.

·  Documented experience of working professionally with authorities on security matters, or a demonstrated ability to build and maintain such relationships.

·  Experience in at least two of the following four core areas: executive protection; family and residential security; event security; or executive travel coordination.

·  Strong judgement and the ability to act autonomously in sensitive situations.

·  Exceptional discretion and interpersonal awareness.

·  Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

·  A valid driver’s license and the ability to travel internationally.

Preferred

·  Experience in a global corporate environment with executive stakeholders.

·  Experience developing and maintaining security programmes, procedures, or playbooks.

·  Experience coordinating with Regional Security teams across multiple geographies.

·  Working knowledge of ISO 31030 (Travel Risk Management) or similar standards.

·  Experience with vendor evaluation, procurement collaboration, and performance oversight.

·  Danish language skills.

Salesforce Solution Architect

Hybrid (minimum of 2-3 days a week from the office)

**Shape the Future of Privacy

**Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

About the Role

Our GTM organization is at an inflection point after reaching more than €100M ARR in 2025. As we scale, our Salesforce ecosystem needs to evolve from a system of record into a true platform for growth – flexible, well-governed and built to support increasingly complex go-to-market motions. You'll be responsible for the technical architecture and long-term health of our Salesforce instance, translating ambitious business requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions.

You'll own the architecture and design standards across our Salesforce ecosystem. This is a hands-on technical role at the intersection of CRM architecture, systems integration and revenue operations. You'll collaborate closely with the GTM leadership team, RevOps, Data and Analytics team to ensure our Salesforce platform scales cleanly alongside the business. Your core accountability is simple: design and steward a Salesforce architecture that is scalable, secure and built to last.

Responsibilities

• Own the end-to-end solution architecture of our Salesforce ecosystem, including data model, security model, sharing rules and integration architecture to support a global, multi-function GTM organisation spanning Self Serve, Partner-Led and High Touch motions.Translate complex business requirements from Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance into scalable, well-governed technical designs.

• Define and enforce architectural standards, coding conventions and release management best practices across the Salesforce platform.

• Design and oversee integrations between Salesforce and the broader GTM tech stack (marketing automation, data enrichment tools, billing, data warehouse) using APIs, middleware and event-driven architecture.

• Partner with RevOps and the GTM org to evaluate buy vs. build decisions and guide platform-native solutions over custom code wherever possible.

• Lead technical design reviews, identify risks or technical debt early and ensure solutions are secure, performant and compliant with data governance requirements.

• Stay at the frontier of the Salesforce ecosystem – continuously evaluate new platform capabilities (Data Cloud, Agentforce, Flow) and bring the right innovations into our architecture roadmap.

Requirements

Experience

• 5+ years of experience in Salesforce architecture, solution engineering or senior Salesforce development roles.

• Proven track record designing and scaling Salesforce architecture in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

Technical Skills

• Deep fluency in Salesforce architecture fundamentals: data modeling, security/sharing model, Flow, Apex, LWC, and integration patterns.

• Strong practical experience designing integrations via REST/SOAP APIs, middleware (MuleSoft, Workato or similar) and event-driven architecture.

• Salesforce Application Architect and/or System Architect certification (or equivalent depth of experience) strongly preferred.

**

Operating Skills**

About Photoncycle

Solar panels make plenty of power in summer and very little in winter, when we need it most. Photoncycle solves that for households. We store energy from the summer sun, so that the it can be used all winter. When there’s excess energy, we sell the surplus to the grid, where it helps balance supply and demand. Households pay a fixed monthly fee; we build, install and operate the system.

Our mission is to accelerate the transition to a more renewable, balanced, and secure energy system. Photoncycle systems enable households to use homegrown energy year-round for electricity, heat, and hot water, while also helping the grid balance production and consumption peaks. This enables the transition away from fossil-based energy.

Our customers are central to that mission. Every home we power is proof that energy independence is possible, and the stories of those homeowners are one of our strongest tools for reaching the next ones.

We are a team of 25 employees across offices in Oslo and Copenhagen. In 2026, we raised a €15 million Series A backed by NordicNinja, Voima Ventures, Lifeline Ventures, Eviny Ventures, Luminar Ventures and Momentum. We're now moving from full-scale pilot to commercial rollout, with the first phase of our production facility coming online in 2027.
